title: National Steam Carnival
description:
National STEAM Carnival Overview

Event Duration: 3 days

Participant Categories
  • Pre-Primary: Play - Class 1
  • Primary: Class 2 - Class 5
  • Junior: Class 6 - Class 8
  • Secondary: Class 9 - Class 10
  • Senior: Class 11 - Class 12, Undergraduates
I. National STEAM Olympiad
  • Final Round: Will be held at BUET. Only the top 3 will receive the grand prize.
II. Olympiads
  • Physics Olympiad
  • Chemistry Olympiad
  • Biology Olympiad
  • General Science Olympiad
  • ICT Olympiad
  • Earth Science Olympiad
  • Math Olympiad
III. Creativity Exhibition
  • Project Display
  • Wall Magazine
  • Scrapbook Display
  • Web Design & Development
  • Craftwork (Pre-primary to Junior)
  • Art Exhibition
  • Art Competition (Only for Pre-Primary to Junior)
  • Photography: Mobile Photography, DSLR Photography
  • Instant Story Writing
IV. Curiosity Zone
  • Workshop
  • Theme-based Food Stall
  • Merchandise Stall
Awards & Prizes
  • Medals
  • Crests
  • Certificates
  • Exclusive Gifts
Registration Fees
  • All Olympiads (Combined): 200 BDT
  • Creativity Exhibition: 200 BDT (Each item)
  • Photography: 300 BDT
  • Curiosity Zone: Workshop is Free. Setup fees for Food & Merchandise stalles vary.

Comprehensive Rules & Regulations

1. STEAM Olympiad: Final Round

Allowed Categories: Primary, Junior, Secondary

  • Use of calculators is strictly prohibited.
  • Format consists of short questions and MCQs.
  • Participants must bring necessary stationeries (pen, pencil, clipboard, etc.).
  • The top 3 performers will be awarded crests and achievement certificates.
2. General Olympiads

Allowed Categories: Primary (General Science only), Junior (General Science, Astronomy & ICT only), Secondary, Senior

  • Time limit: 20 minutes per olympiad.
  • Use of calculators is strictly prohibited.
  • Format consists of short questions and MCQs.
  • Participants must bring necessary stationeries.
3. Project Display

Allowed Categories: Junior, Secondary, Senior

  • Teams must consist of exactly 3 members. Members may be from different institutions.
  • Categories: Mechanical and Non-mechanical.
  • Acceptable Themes: Space, Astronomy, Science, Environmental Science, Scientific Business plan.
  • Projects must be submitted on the first day of the event. Please arrive 1 hour early.
  • Electricity will be provided, but participants must bring their own multi-plugs and laptops.
  • Judging criteria: Aesthetics, explanation, and presentation.
4. Wall Magazine

Allowed Categories: Junior, Secondary, Senior

  • Teams must consist of 3 members from any institution.
  • Acceptable Themes: Space, Astronomy, Science, Environmental Science, Scientific Business plan.
  • Maximum size limit: 8x8 feet. Shape and thickness are unrestricted.
  • Any type of crafting materials may be used.
  • Must be submitted on the first day. Judging criteria: Planning, beauty, and presentation.
5. Scrapbook Display

Allowed Categories: Junior, Secondary, Senior

  • Teams must consist of 3 members from any institution.
  • Maximum size limit: 8x8 feet.
  • Any type of materials may be used.
  • Must be submitted on the first day. Judging criteria: Planning, beauty, and presentation.
6. Instant Story Writing

Allowed Categories: Junior, Secondary, Senior

  • Time limit: 1 hour.
  • Topics must relate to science, space, astronomy, or a scientific business.
  • Language: Exclusively Bengali OR exclusively English (mixing is prohibited).
  • Maximum word count: 300 words.
  • Judging criteria: Storyline, data accuracy, and proper grammar utilization.
7. Art Exhibition

Allowed Categories: Junior, Secondary, Senior

  • Theme: Astronomy, Space, Technology & Science.
  • No digital artworks permitted. Both sketch and colored art are accepted.
  • Allowed canvas/paper sizes (inches): 8x8, 10x8, 12x8, 12x12, 20x12, 20x20.
  • Participants may use any medium. Artworks must be signed by the creator.
  • Stolen or copied artwork will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Captions are mandatory (English or Bengali), written on the back or attached to the artwork alongside the Participant's Name and Institution.
  • Authorities reserve the right to decline submissions containing inappropriate themes (nudity, violence, politics).
  • No alterations allowed post-submission. Artworks must be submitted by the first day.
8. Art Competition

Allowed Categories: Pre-Primary, Primary, Junior

  • Time limit: 1 hour.
  • Theme: Open.
  • Participants must bring their own art materials (colors, board, pencils, etc.). Both sketch and colored art are permitted.
9. Photography Exhibition

Allowed Categories: Open for all (Mobile & DSLR)

  • Photos must be submitted before the event via a high-resolution downloadable drive link.
  • Limit: 1 photo per participant.
  • Stolen or copied photos will result in disqualification.
  • Captions are mandatory (English or Bengali).
  • All accepted submissions will be framed and displayed. Participants may collect their framed photos afterward.
10. Web Design & Development

Allowed Categories: Junior, Secondary, Senior

  • Websites must be submitted on the first day.
  • Copied or stolen designs will lead to disqualification.
  • Judging criteria: Presentation, appearance, UI/UX, and information architecture.
11. Craftwork

Allowed Categories: Pre-Primary, Primary, Junior

  • Theme: Open. No size restrictions.
  • Must be submitted on the first day. Post-submission alterations or retractions are prohibited.
  • Judging criteria: Appearance, presentation, and thematic relevance.

title: National STEAM Olympiad
description:
Join us for the National STEAM Olympiad — a premier multi-discipline competition designed to inspire young minds across Bangladesh. Compete in STEAM Olympiad, Art, and Photography segments. All registrations are individual (solo).

Venue
House-17, Road-03, Block-B, Shenpara Parbata, Mirpur-10, Dhaka-1216
Contact
+880 1857-108193
Email

Categories

Elementary — Class 1–3 Primary — Class 4–5 Junior — Class 6–8 Secondary — Class 9–10 Senior — Class 11–12+

Registration Fees

200 BDT
STEAM Olympiad
200 BDT
Art Exhibition / Competition
300 BDT
Photography

Prizes & Awards

Medals for selected & winners
Participant Certificates for all
Appreciation Certificates (Olympiad winners)
Crests for top performers

Segment Details

STEAM Olympiad — 200 BDT
All 5 categories eligible.
  • Organized in two rounds: Selection Round and Final Round.
  • Final Round will be held alongside the National STEAM Carnival.
  • Selection Round is institution-based.
  • Using a calculator is prohibited.
  • Format: Short questions / MCQ.
  • Participants must bring their own stationery (pen, pencil, board, etc.).
  • Top 100 of Selection Round receive medals and achievement certificates.
  • Top 300 of Selection Round advance to the Final Round.
Art Exhibition & Competition — 200 BDT
Art Exhibition — Junior, Secondary & Senior
  • Theme: Astronomy, Space, Technology & Science.
  • Digital artworks are not permitted.
  • Participants may submit sketch and/or colored art.
  • Canvas/paper sizes: 8×8", 10×8", 12×8", 12×12", 20×12", 20×20" (inches).
  • Any art materials are permitted.
  • Participants must sign their artwork.
  • Stolen or copied artwork will be disqualified.
  • Captions are mandatory (English or Bangla) — include Caption, Name, and Institution on the back of the artwork.
  • Authorities may decline artworks containing nudity, violence, or political content.
  • No changes allowed after submission.
  • Artwork must be submitted by the first day of the event. All submitted artworks will be displayed.
Art Competition Primary & Junior Only
  • Only for Primary (Class 1–5) and Junior (Class 6–8) participants.
  • Participants have 1 hour to complete their artwork.
  • Bring your own materials: color pencils, board, pencil, eraser, sharpener, etc.
  • Both sketch and colored art are accepted.
  • Theme: Open.
Photography Exhibition — 300 BDT
Mobile Photography & DSLR Photography
  • Photos must be submitted before the event — this is a pre-registration exhibition.
  • All photos will be framed and displayed at the event.
  • Submit photos in high-resolution via a downloadable drive link.
  • Each participant may submit one photo.
  • Stolen or copied photos will be disqualified.
  • Captions are mandatory (English or Bangla) — include Caption, Name, and Institution with the photo / in the registration form.
  • Authorities may decline photos containing nudity, violence, or political content.
  • No changes allowed after submission.
  • Participants may take back their framed photos after the event.
location: SOS HERMANN GMEINER COLLEGE DHAKA, Plot No. 3-B, Block-A, Section-13, Mirpur, Dhaka-1216, Bangladesh
